notes.title: Update 0.25.6
notes.notes:
Hi guys. Thank you so much to everyone who experienced the game. I watched your gameplay videos and received your comments 😍 I noticed that one of the puzzles seems a bit difficult. That's why I tried to add more hints for it in this update, and I also made some minor changes to improve the gaming experience. I hope you enjoy the game. I'm looking forward to your videos and comments 😉🎮

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45309154/41371eb761cd5eb0f0170840ad521ec895b5732e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Chapter One is coming!
notes.notes:
Hi guys. There are only a few hours left until the release of the first chapter of my new game titled [b]A Hole In My Room[/b] on Steam 😱🎮 This game was supposed to be part of the Silence Channel before, but due to the art style and some differences in gameplay, I tried to release it under a different title. I hope you enjoy it. I'm looking forward to your comments, and don't forget to add the game to your [b]Wishlist[/b]. doing this really helps me a lot in completing the game 🙏

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45309154/c5192ca5a5e2f0550c85030a405ee232e10289ff.jpg[/img]
